tags.description: Silverhorn Creek is an RV-friendly campground offering a rustic camping experience along the Icefields Parkway. Campsites are unserviced and best suited for tents, or motorhomes and trailers up to 20 meters (70 feet).
tags.name: Silverhorn Creek Campground
